summary: Nautilus Biotechnology filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026 disclosing entry into a Sales Agreement with TD Securities (USA), LLC (TD Cowen) for an at-the-market offering program of up to $125,000,000 in common stock, and termination of a material definitive agreement. TD Cowen acts as sales agent using commercially reasonable efforts at market prices under Rule 415, earning up to 3.0% of gross proceeds; the company controls sale parameters and may suspend or terminate on ten days' notice. Shares issue under a newly filed Form S-3 shelf. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any terminated-agreement detail.
